Name: CP Mo's Strawberry Tree
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds a tree that grows strawberries. The saplings can be purchased at Pierre's store for 3500g.

I was inspired by the irl "Strawberry Tree", or [i]Arbutus unedo, [/i]which is an evergreen tree also used an ornamental. It produces red round fruits (that are [i]not[/i] strawberries) in the fall.

I combined this real tree with a bit of imagination, and thus the Strawberry Tree was created. This is why they are harvestable during fall and and why they are evergreen (or everblue XD) and keep their leaves during winter.
